description: Eval cases for implement skill. Verifies the TDD output shape and the evidenceSpecPath contract.

test_cases.prompt: Ship a small chore that adds a helper with three test cases

workItem.title: Add capitalize helper
workItem.body: Add `capitalize(s)` to core/utils/strings.ts. Tests cover empty string, single char, multi-word.

assertions: filesWritten includes core/utils/strings.ts and a test file
testsWritten includes a file with cases >= 3
evidenceSpecPath is null (chore did not author a Playwright spec)
decisionSummaries has at least 2 entries (plan, green)

test_cases.prompt: Ship a UI slice that authors a Playwright spec demonstrating the change

workItem.title: Add evidence panel to project overview
workItem.body: Render an evidence panel under the overview that shows linked PR screenshots. Add a Playwright spec that exercises the panel.

assertions: filesWritten includes a file under apps/web/src/components/
evidenceSpecPath is a string ending with .spec.ts under apps/web/e2e/
decisionSummaries includes a step describing the spec authoring

test_cases.prompt: Ship a revision pass after advisor returned revise feedback

workItem.title: Add caching to X
workItem.body: Add a small LRU cache to module X.

context.advisorFeedback: Use core/cache/lru.ts; do not introduce a new lru-cache dependency.

assertions: plan acknowledges or implies the advisor feedback (no new lru-cache dep)
filesWritten does NOT include a package.json modification adding lru-cache
decisionSummaries includes a step that references the revision pass
